long_biography.plain_text:
South Port was among the first multi-family projects delivered by Fred Bucci and development manager Greg Nelson. Bucci had assembled income-producing property through Bucci Investments before forming a separate development arm, which went on to build homes across Western Canada. Its work now ranges from apartment and condominium communities to mixed residential and commercial projects.

Bucci also took his experience into industry leadership. He served as president of the Urban Development Institute's Pacific region and then its national organisation. His son Mike joined the family firm and came to lead several residential projects, while Fred continued to oversee the investment and development companies. The business remains active in both Vancouver and Calgary.
